name: State Wire & Terminal, Inc.
old_description: We’ve been saving our customers’ time, energy, and helping their bottom lines since 1973. We get you the parts you need fast and working with an industry leader like us couldn’t be easier. Based outside of Detroit, Michigan, we distribute electrical components for maintenance and repair applications in a variety of industries across the United States. We offer over 100,000 quality parts from industry-leading manufacturers like 3M, Deutsch, Hellerman Tyton, and Pollak with 12,000+ products available for same-day shipping. Working with us is simple: we manage your inventory and replacement component needs, so you can get back to managing your business. Our inventory management system anticipates your company’s needs and helps ensure you never run out of critical parts. And when you do need to restock, our knowledgeable and friendly customer service staff is there to help!
about:
State Wire & Terminal, Inc. has operated from Auburn Hills, Michigan, just outside Detroit, since its founding in 1973. The company began as a supplier of electrical components for maintenance and repair applications, building a catalog that now spans more than 100,000 items sourced from manufacturers such as 3M, Deutsch, HellermannTyton, and Pollak.

The distributor stocks over 12,000 products for same-day shipping and runs an inventory management system designed to anticipate customer replenishment needs. A will-call counter at the Auburn Hills facility allows immediate pickup of hundreds of items, while air freight service is available on request. The product range includes battery and trailer components, as well as storage solutions such as rack systems, bin cabinets, and wire spool organizers.

Customers span trucking, utilities, government and municipal fleets, recreational vehicles, marine, and construction sectors, along with hospitals, HVAC contractors, schools, and farms — essentially any operation that relies on motor-powered equipment.

The company emphasizes reducing downtime by managing replacement component logistics, offering 24-hour shipping on available stock and same-day dispatch of backorders once received. Its stated goal is to let clients focus on their core business while State Wire handles the sourcing and delivery of critical electrical parts.
